competency_fulfillment.rationale: All seven samples measure 'the length of an object' using non-standard units, paperclips in seeds 42/43/46/55, blocks in 44/50, steps in 45, matching the first half of the competency well, but not one sample measures 'the distance between two objects', the competency's explicitly named second task.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The competency names two sub-tasks, object length and distance between two objects; 'distance between two objects' has zero representation across all seven seeds -- no sample places two objects and asks for the gap between them.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The recurring stem 'Measure the object. Its length is ___ [unit].' is a short, two-clause instruction appropriate for Grade 1 Quarter 2.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Three distinct non-standard units appear, paperclips, blocks, steps, across four different formatters, mcq, cloze, read_mcq, giving reasonable presentation variety for the length-measuring half of the competency.

competency_alignment.rationale: All variation is in unit type and target length, 5 vs 10 units across seeds 42-55, directly building the 'measure using non-standard units' skill without drifting into standard units like centimeters.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Measured lengths of 5 and 10 units across all seven samples are small, easily countable magnitudes appropriate to Grade 1 Quarter 2 non-standard measurement.
